task.title: P6-122: Prune stale entries from the selection tray
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-122. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Selection-tray entries go stale and nothing prunes them** (was `P6-046g`). A key can reference a holding or collection invalidated by a later stepper commit, teardown or deletion; there is no prune or invalidate logic anywhere in `selection_tray.rs`. Harmless while the tray was read-only — batch move writes, so it needs a stale-entry policy now.
